## Natural history notes

A small, smooth-scaled lizard characterized by its shiny body, five pale stripes, and a bright blue tail in juveniles. In Florida, it is found in dry to mesic habitats such as pine flatwoods, scrub, hammocks, forest edges, and suburban yards with logs, leaf litter, or other cover. It is active during the day and feeds mainly on insects and other small invertebrates, often darting quickly into cover when disturbed.
